name: scaffold-hbar-template
description: Hedera-native Next.js template (HCS, HTS, Mirror Node) without local Solidity workspaces.

steps.text: Hedera native services only (HCS, HTS, Mirror Node): no contract deploy is required.

steps.label: Set the operator and WalletConnect variables
steps.text: HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY from a testnet account; NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID from Reown Cloud.

steps.label: Bootstrap testnet resources
steps.text: Idempotent: creates what is missing and writes the ids to packages/nextjs/.env.local.

steps.label: Try the demo
steps.text: Connect HashPack, post a proof on the home page and watch it appear in the feed.

steps.label: Runbook
steps.text: docs/RUNBOOK.md — reproduce on testnet end to end, verify with the Mirror Node and HashScan, troubleshoot.

steps.label: Architecture
steps.text: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — signing flows, module map, verified network constraints.
